baseRig: goblin-grunt (Meshy 24-bone), rest pose in the GLB nodes

retarget.howto: per bone b, parents first: D = Wpack_now(b) * inv(Wpack_rest(b)); C(b) = shortest rotation turning the unit rest direction (b -> child joint, world) onto the pack rest direction; bones without a child (hands, toes, head_end, headfront) use the parent C; Hips uses identity. Wunit_now(b) = D * C(b) * Wunit_rest(b); local = inv(Wunit_now(parent)) * Wunit_now(b). Hips position = unit rest + (pack hips world offset from rest) * legRatio, in the hips parent space. legRatio = unit leg / packLegLength (LeftUpLeg->LeftLeg->LeftFoot->LeftToeBase joint distances, world). Reference: ohrt-retarget-reference.py (numpy, glTF nodes).

notes: Clips are in place; game moves the unit. walk/run: move at rootSpeed * legRatio (m/s).
knockback/bowled: move the unit between events launch and land; they end back in base pose.
defeat clips end lying (up to ~0.4 m off the tile on the pack rig). On the tall golem the lying body floats 4-11% of its height: optional per-unit ground snap for defeat.
Some units have uneven leg lengths (golem left ankle sits higher in its own Meshy idle), so a foot can hover 2-8% of height during walk/run on those units; optional foot IK later.
Right hand is the weapon hand; props ride the RightHand bone.
